verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a sandbox with test institutions/accounts simulating the real Open Banking experience, plus API references for accounts/transactions/authorisation flows and error handling patterns via webhooks. However, there is no evidence of documented test credentials, explicit error-state simulation guidance, or a hands-on walkthrough confirming end-to-end sandbox usage. missing for 10: documented test credentials, explicit error-state/failure simulation examples, independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox completeness.
